subject: Strategic briefing — delegation, QBR prep & escalation lanes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: leadership@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic briefing — delegation, QBR prep & escalation lanes

Hello leadership team,

Quick weekly pulse ahead of next week's QBR planning slot. I focused this note on three areas: 1) what moved, 2) what could block our QBR narrative, and 3) concrete asks with owners/dates. Please scan and call out anything that needs to be elevated.

Wins (what we can highlight in QBR)
- Serving runtime: 98th-pct latency for text generation decreased from 720ms -> 632ms over the last sprint (12% improvement) after the kernel selector rollout. Data attached.
- Redwood Dedicated: two new mid-market customers contracted for reserved capacity in EMEA (adds predictable ARR and makes our Dedicated case study richer).
- Optimize pilot: Intelligent batching reduced per-token CPU by ~18% on average for the evaluated workload.

Risks (items to reconcile before QBR)
- Model onboarding backlog: three open verification tickets (FPQ-ids in drive link) are delaying our ability to showcase the latest quantized variant in-hosted benchmarks. Impact: may weaken our performance narrative. Owner: Karthik — please provide ETA.
- SOC evidence gap: Acme procurement has flagged that our recent audit artifacts don't contain explicit KV-cache retention timestamps they require for procurement sign-off. Impact: may delay contract signature. External contact: Emily Zhang / ProcureOps. Owner: Soojin — short remediation plan requested.
- Capacity SLO delta: internal testing shows a potential throughput dip on multi-tenant bursts for sequences >2k. We need a contingency rollout plan to avoid SLA slippage with Dedicated customers. Owner: Jonas.

Asks / Decisions needed (short, owner, due)
- Karthik: Deliver onboarding ticket ETAs and prioritize the top blocker (ticket #FPQ-482) by 7/20.
- Soojin: Provide SOC evidence addendum and point person to liaise with Acme by EOD 7/19. I'll loop legal if redlines are needed.
- Jonas & Runtime team: Share fallback routing policy (document + one-slide summary) by 7/21 for the QBR appendix.
- Laura: Confirm whether we want to surface the mid-market Dedicated wins as a mini-case — decision by 7/20 so we can design the slide.

Attachments: QBR-appendix-OKR-snapshot.xlsx (OKR progress and slides), Service-Latency-98pct-trend.png (chart)

I'll schedule a 30-minute pre-QBR sync if folks want to walk through the slides; otherwise I'll consolidate updates and circulate a final packet on 7/22 morning PT.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, leadership@redwood.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic briefing — delegation, QBR prep & escalation lanes

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple quick notes: 

- Please surface the mid-market Dedicated EMEA contracts; that demonstrates runway for Dedicated price/packaging in the field. I'll sign off on a short customer quote if we can get permissions.
- Karthik: If onboarding backlog impacts the ability to demo quantized variant, propose an alternate demo (same latency/throughput story using a compatible model) by EOD 7/20. We don't want a blank spot in the narrative.
- Soojin: prioritize response to Acme — procurement delays are a hard gating item. If we need to offer a temporary attest or extra phone call to close the loop, let's do it.

One ask for Marissa: If you can add a one-line impact statement for each risk in the slide appendix (what does missing this mean for customers and revenue), that'll help execs decide prioritization quickly.

Laura

Subject: Re: Strategic briefing — delegation, QBR prep & escalation lanes

Adding a quick mitigation for the capacity SLO delta:
- Root cause appears to be the KV-cache eviction policy under high-concurrency >2k sequences. Runtime team has a patch that reduces synchronous eviction calls and defers non-critical GC.
- Impact: should remove the throughput dip in most cases; we need to validate with a live multi-tenant replay by 7/20.
- Ask: Marissa, can you mark this as "go/no-go" if the rehearse shows no regressions? If we see regressions, we'll trigger the fallback routing policy Laura mentioned.

Jonas

Thanks all — quick confirmations and next steps: 
- Karthik: confirm ticket ETAs by 7/20. If ETA slips, flag blocker and we'll pull in Applied ML to triage.
- Soojin: start the Acme evidence addendum and copy me. If we need an interim assurance note, I'll prep one with Legal. Target: 7/19.
- Jonas: run the multi-tenant replay and share results in the QBR folder; mark readiness by 7/21.
- Laura: you'll have the customer quote permission by EOD 7/20 — thanks.

I'll run the pre-QBR sync on 7/22 09:00 PT — calendar invite to follow. If any of you cannot make the slot, please drop updates in the shared doc.

Marissa
